description: Runs as the hosted Renovate App. The spokes that extend this same preset run renovate.yml on their own token instead, because a bot pull request there would run a plan that holds cloud credentials. Nothing here logs in to a cloud, and the App's pull requests start CI at once, so they report the ci-passed check the main ruleset requires.

customManagers.description: The BuildKit image every image-pipeline build runs on, by tag and digest. Its digest moves with its tag.
The buildx release the image pipeline installs through docker/setup-buildx-action.
The gitleaks version the quality workflow downloads, written under a renovate comment that names its datasource and package, since no action installs it.

packageRules.description: The GitHub Actions manager is on only for the tool versions the setup actions take as inputs: tflint and trivy. Dependabot keeps every action SHA.

The quality workflow, this repository's own hook and the OpenTofu bar's hook config each name a gitleaks version. One pull request moves every copy, so the bar's local gitleaks never trails the history scan.
